items.reason: The only tissue endpoint is "Histologic tumor devitalization: Evaluating cell fate and cell death via histologic samples after GBM resection", a post-treatment histologic response measure with no paired pre/post sampling and no named target or pharmacodynamic marker; response endpoints are not target engagement. It could be read as a tissue pharmacodynamic effect of SDT.

note: Only the secondary variable target_engagement_planned is in doubt (window design: SDT 1-3 weeks before resection, tissue assessed for cell death). Screening and candidate status are not affected. No D31 convention settles it: D31-C6 covers a stated PD objective without a measurement, but this record states no PD objective. Still needs XL.
